meta.name: Chumbak
meta.description: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When Kuku goes missing, Rajni enlists her eccentric neighbors to help find him. But her search soon reveals a frustrating truth about her marriage.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Rajni struggles to tell Kuku her decision, the couples across Chumbak Colony reassess their own relationships.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Split over the decision to divorce, Rajni and Kuku seek legal counsel. Dharmendra's unconventional work causes a stir at his daughter's school.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Rajni and Kuku come to an agreement in court. While the men reflect on their marriages, a Bollywood-themed ladies' night goes awry.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The husbands rush to free their wives from jail as Micky scrambles to hide his affair. Kuku's account of a mystery woman puts Rajni on alert.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Kuku's memory of the elusive woman sparks questions across the colony. Nari organizes a memorial for his beloved pet python.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Rajni's connection with singer Ronit has her friends playing cupid. Priyanka and Adi deal with their son Ruhaan's trouble at school.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The colony scrambles to find Ruhaan after he runs away from home. But Priyanka and Adi soon face a major surprise.
